notes.title: Crime: 1997 - Mission Gameplay
notes.content:
Hi!

Developments of Crime: 1997 are progressing very well, and we wanted to show you a little taste of the gameplay. Within the game there will be Secondary Missions related to the "Phone Killer" this mysterious figure will offer us missions where we will need to take out a certain target, retrieve items from some clients, and much more

Josh Portillo is the voice actor behind the Phone Killer who has decided to collaborate with us within the Crime: 1997 project, we can't wait to show you more

New updates coming soon!

Bad Guys Games

notes.title: Crime: 1997 - News and Developments
notes.content:
Hi Guys!

It's been a while since the last updates. This 2024 has been quite intense which has somewhat slowed down the development of the game, it has not been suspended or stopped altogether. But I can warn you that it is now in full swing from the free time I have. I can tell you that a Demo of Crime: 1997 will be released in the first half of 2025. We want to bring you a great experience that you deserve to play and try, we are so keen to know that interest has been shown on the development anyway. Thank you for your support, and to that end I am attaching screenshots from the Demo version with a little gameplay showing some mechanics that we are just finishing up

Thank you for everything! We wish you a very Happy 2025

Bad Guys Games Team

notes.title: Crime: 1997 - Trailer 2 coming on Feb. 20, 2024
notes.content: On February 20, 2024 we will be releasing the second trailer for our project that we will be releasing this year, with audio tracks created by Davide Cappello, this trailer will feature a release date for the Demo, and a release date for the full game coming in late mid-2024. We look forward to showing you more updates in the future, in the meantime we are proud to show you some screenshots from the Gameplay of Crime: 1997
